samplingRules.session: Each question uses a fresh session with no project context or supplied site content; record whether web search is enabled.
samplingRules.repeat: Record the exact provider, visible model label, date/time, locale and question. Do not infer an unavailable model version.
samplingRules.separation: Discovery questions and questions explicitly naming the domain are reported separately. A citation is not a visit, and no mention is not an indexing diagnosis.
samplingRules.traffic: Use first-party analytics only when configured; referral visits are currently unmeasured.
samplingRules.cadence: Suggested manual baseline and post-release repeats; no automation has been scheduled.
